approved: Higher Education Support Amendment (End Dirty University Partnerships) Bill 2025
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would stop universities that get Commonwealth money from having financial ties with certain harmful industries.
Universities would have to reveal all current partnerships with those industries and sell off any related investments.
The bill names the fossil fuel, gambling, tobacco and weapons industries and lets the minister add more industries by a legislative instrument.
Prohibits monetary partnerships between Commonwealth-funded universities and identified harmful industries.
Requires universities to disclose and divest from all partnerships and investments with those industries.
Bans universities from appointing leaders who have investments in those industries to their governing body.
Commonwealth-funded universities and their governing bodies.

Moved to suspend standing orders and restore the Australian Education Legislation Amendment (Prohibiting the Indoctrination of Children) Bill 2020 and twelve other listed bills to the Notice Paper for consideration at the second reading stage; both questions were agreed to.
